text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just before training was about to begin,
while searching for Grass Wonder—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's just not going in well...
Maybe it's the snap of my wrist...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah—excuse me, Trainer.
Is it about time for training?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm practicing my free throws. You see, I'm supposed to play in a basketball match with my classmates...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to do it,
I don't intend to lose, no matter the contest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me.
We still have five minutes until training starts, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having practiced free throws right up until the last moment,
Grass Wonder seemed to have expended
more energy than usual.
